content:
alex: Quick sync — planning a staggered wave deploy for the batching micro-opt. Targeting 09:00 UTC canary (10%), then 30% at +20m, 60% at +40m if green. Need deploy owner, smoke checker, rollback ready. Rolling image + config tweak.

raj: I can own the deploy. I'll be at my laptop 08:50 UTC. Which image tag and any extra flags?

alex: tag `service:2026-03-18-batch-opt-rc3`. Config `canary-config.v2` with `batch_window_ms=8`. Routing will use `traffic_tag=wave-2026-03-18`. Ops doc link: https://confluence.redwood/release/wave-2026-03-18

sara: I'll run smoke checks. What's the quick checklist?

alex: Smoke checklist (short):
1) `curl -I https://canary.redwood/api/health` expect 200
2) run `./scripts/smoke.sh --cohort=canary` (20 runs)
3) verify p50/p95 latency on Datadog dashboard < thresholds and error rate < 0.5%
4) sanity-check embedding endpoints with a couple of prompts

raj: Paste of smoke script so it's easy to run:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
curl -f https://canary.redwood/api/health
python ci/smoke.py --target canary --runs 20
```

marco: tagging @ops-oncall to watch infra metrics during ramp. Also confirm rollback image tag please.

ops-oncall: watching. Rollback plan: if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 > baseline +200ms for 5m, do rollback. Rollback command (k8s):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/model-service model=service:2026-03-17-stable -n production
```
and open rollback ticket `RL-2026-0318-wave` and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout at 09:00 UTC by raj — ramp plan 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 20m evaluation windows.

sara: I'll post a short smoke report at +5m, +25m, +45m. If anything spikes I'll call it.

alex: Cohort selection: only `beta` customer segment + internal accounts in eu-west. No paid traffic. Flagging the feature gate `wave_beta_only=true`.

raj: Confirmed. I'll set the routing and start pre-checks at 08:58. Will run `kubectl apply -f canary.yaml` at 09:00.

sara: Can you add me to the logs dashboard and give read on the canary metrics?

alex: Done — added to `redwood-deployers` and `canary-watches`. You should have a Datadog link in your email.

marco: Quick CR reminder: PR #1234 contains the config bump and small handler change. @alex can you give a last pass?

alex: Reviewing now. LGTM except one tiny nit in comments, will approve in 2m.

raj: I'll start the preflight (dry-run) at 08:58 and post here. If approved, full apply at 09:00.

sara: Running smoke at +5m after canary is live, then the other checks at each ramp point. I'll paste results here.

alex: Thanks all. If ops-oncall sees anything odd, escalate to pager immediately. :thumbsup:

raj: Preflight done at 08:59 — manifest validated, readiness probes ok. Ready to apply in 1m.

sara: Ready on my side. Dashboards open, log tails on.

deploy-bot: Canary applied — 10% live. (09:00 UTC)

raj: 10% is live. Posting link to canary traffic split UI: https://console.redwood/traffic/wave-2026-03-18

sara: Running smoke now — posting results in 3m.

marco: I'm watching infra; no anomalous spikes yet.

ops-oncall: Alert thresholds armed. Will call rollback if rule triggers.

sara: Smoke + checks: health OK, p50 82ms, p95 210ms (within threshold), error rate 0.12%. Good to ramp to 30%.

raj: Bumping to 30% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic bumped to 30% (09:20 UTC)

sara: Running second smoke for 30% — will report in 3m.

marco: No infra signs. Disk, GPU, queue lengths all normal.

sara: 30% smoke: p50 88ms, p95 230ms, errors 0.18%. Still green. Recommend continue to 60%.

raj: Bumping to 60% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic bumped to 60% (09:40 UTC)

marco: Observability steady. Keep watching edge caches.

sara: Final checks done. Everything within expected ranges. No action required.

alex: Nice work. I'll merge and close the wave checklist. Thanks team.

raj: Closing out deploy now and will file postmortem notes tomorrow with perf numbers.

sara: Posting smoke logs to the release thread and attaching run artifacts.

ops-oncall: All quiet. Stand down, but I'll keep a loose eye for the next hour.

alex: Appreciated. If anything crops up ping here or call the pager.

raj: Thanks everyone. :rocket:
